inputs.complete_coverage: boolean proven from exact governed-component identity closure
inputs.all_governed_components_nonempty: boolean proven from every governed component typed authority state/value binding
inputs.unanimous_authoritative_value: boolean proven only after complete coverage and non-empty authority for every governed component

dispositions.SCALARIZED_COMPLETE_UNANIMOUS_NONEMPTY: scalar projection lawful; exact vector and proof remain authoritative lineage
dispositions.VECTOR_HETEROGENEOUS_COMPLETE: complete and non-empty but two or more authoritative values differ; scalar forbidden
dispositions.VECTOR_INCOMPLETE_COVERAGE: governed component set not completely and exactly dispositioned; scalar forbidden regardless of matched-subset agreement
dispositions.VECTOR_GOVERNED_EMPTY_COMPONENT: complete identity coverage includes a lawfully empty component; scalar forbidden
dispositions.VECTOR_DENIED_OR_NONCOMPARABLE_COMPONENT: one or more governed components carries denial/noncomparability; scalar forbidden unless a separately accepted authority explicitly defines another operation

forbidden_operations: treat resolved subset as full governed set

required_hostile_cases.additional_oracle: publication/reload preserves every component producer ref exactly and cannot alter scalar disposition or semantic ownership

historical_basis: Accepted Section35 component-aware bridge law recovered in R03/R04 and adopted by Authority 32
negative_ceiling: A computed equality is not an authorized scalar semantic object absent a governed common projection receipt.
